query: What goal-management practices support high achievement?

per_column.name: goal_domain
per_column.rationale: Well-grounded categorization derivable from description/category, though it largely mirrors the existing 'category' column, limiting its novel analytical leverage. Still allows grouping achievement by domain.

per_column.name: improvement_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Captures the HOW of each goal (e.g. customer_engagement, employee_development), a genuine new axis directly relevant to 'practices that support achievement.' Samples read soundly from the described means, though resource_allocation labeling of the first row is a reasonable inference.

per_column.name: quantitative_target_specificity
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to goal-setting best practice (specificity). Values correctly distinguish percentage-only vs. with-baseline from text; well grounded across samples.

per_column.name: timeline_specificity
per_column.rationale: Time-bound framing is a core goal-management practice; provides a strong grouping axis. Samples (fiscal_year, specific_quarter, next_year) match the text well.

per_column.name: implementation_scope
per_column.rationale: Useful scope dimension for comparing achievement. Mostly sound, but 'organization_wide' is inferred fairly liberally for rows where the text does not explicitly state scope (e.g. the meetings efficiency goal), a mild over-assertion.

per_column.name: baseline_reference_specified
per_column.rationale: Conceptually useful but largely redundant with quantitative_target_specificity's 'percentage_with_baseline'. Groundedness weakened by inconsistency: the employee-satisfaction row states 75%-to-85% (a baseline) yet is marked False, contradicting the text.

per_column.name: technology_enablement
per_column.rationale: A boolean lever that adds a distinct axis for whether tech drives the goal; relevant to practices. Sample values plausibly grounded (all False here match text lacking tech mention).

per_column.name: employee_engagement_lever
per_column.rationale: Meaningful lever distinct from goal_domain; the engagement-program row is correctly True. Well grounded in the described interventions.

per_column.name: stakeholder_coordination_requirement
per_column.rationale: Coordination requirements are a strong axis for explaining achievement. However several assignments are inferential (e.g. 'cross_functional_required' for the status-meetings goal, 'single_owner' for cost reduction) where the text does not clearly specify coordination needs.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuine analytical axes (target specificity, timeline framing, improvement mechanism, coordination, engagement/technology levers) that are highly pertinent to identifying goal-management practices supporting high achievement, and most are cleanly derivable from the description text. Weaknesses: goal_domain largely duplicates the existing category column, baseline_reference_specified overlaps quantitative_target_specificity and shows an internal contradiction (baseline present yet marked False), and scope/coordination columns rely on somewhat liberal inference beyond what silent rows state. Overall the set is useful and mostly grounded with a few over-asserted values.
